summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK MAR-standard notification of a PDMR share dealing by CEO Fernando Fernandez, who sold 30,158 GBP-denominated ordinary shares at GBP 48.901367 and 63,115 EUR-denominated shares at EUR 58.474285 on 2026-10-30 across the London Stock Exchange and Euronext Amsterdam, for stated personal financial planning. Post-trade beneficial ownership with connected persons is 199,132 shares, roughly 715% of base salary versus a 700% requirement; a further 233,061 shares sit under 2024-2028 PSP awards vesting 0-200% of target. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics apply; this is a routine insider-dealing disclosure, not a special situation.
